column2: Don't mess with me!\n\nI... I'll never accept that!
Shusha-kun, it's terrible! {p}-kun is gone!
Akira-kun and Ryo-kun are nowhere to be seen either!\n\nThey may have slipped out from somewhere.
Would you!? ...But will you make it in time?
Thank you, Great King Enma! Now we can turn the battle around!
Good! Shusha-kun, I'm leaving the rest to you!
Ha! That's just like him.\n\nAll right! We'll rescue Getter Robo. Shusha, you go find {p}!
Thank you, Great King Enma! Now we can turn the battle around!
Right now, the more fighters the better. Shusha-kun, I'll come with you.
What do you think that is?
Looks like light shining in...
M-my body's floating up!?
Whoaaa!
Whoooa!
Huh, Shusha-kun...? Where... are we?
Inside the castle built on the Hill of Beginnings! We came to rescue you!
Then we're...
Out of that place!
A black moon!? {p}, watch yourself!
Get out of the light, {p}-kun!
No good! It won't make a peep!
A lot of time has passed since then...
That should free Getter Robo!
All right! I can move!
Ryo! Here they come!
This time, shake 'em to pieces!
Ryo! The sky! Look at that!!
Yikes!
The moon!? So it's finally come out...
{p}, are you okay!
Akira-kun!
Relax, he's fine!
Akira-kun!
Sorry to keep you waiting, {p}!
Akira-kun, how did you get here?
Shinichi foresaw where you'd gone. And Shingo Shusha teleported us here!
So this isn't our own world after all!
It's a patchwork world the Demon King made!\n\nDemon King! I can't help but fight you!
It was because Miki was there that I didn't lose my human heart. But now Miki's gone too...\n\nI know exactly how you feel, way too well, {p}...
From the patchwork world the Demon King made?
Our true fate, huh... But Miki's already...
Really!?
What's wrong, Kikunosuke?
Heh, I just got lonely, thinking it's time to say goodbye!
Kikunosuke...
{p}, it was a blast! See ya!
Yeah!
You're not half bad, kid!\n\nIf you're ever in a jam, come to the Abashiri Family anytime!
I'd love to see you again, sweetie!
Let's cut loose together again! Gahahaha!
Don't you forget Kichiza!
I'd like a family like that too...
I'll teach you karate sometime! A man's gotta be strong!
Judo's good too! I'll teach ya the Great Snow Mountain Drop!
Yeah! Go easy on me!
Better not spend too much time with these two. Your brain'll turn into muscle.
Hayato! Why you...!
That's goin' too far!
Stay good friends forever, everyone!
Someday I want to join the Getter Team too!
I feel like I learned a lot of things. As long as I've got my friends at the Quake Fort, I'm not scared of grown-ups' violence!
They're great friends!
Someday I'm gonna make Kanto a place where people can live in peace and safety. A place where grown-ups and kids alike can live together as friends!
...I wonder if it'll go that well.
It will!
Just watch, Jack!
Ryu Takuma! I know you can do it!
You've grown so much stronger since we first met.
Huh? R-really?
If something like this ever happens again, I'd like to go with you next time.
But I've had enough of this kind of thing!
Fair enough!
Honey was such a wonderful person...
Looks like it's finally just us.
Akira-kun...
I became Devilman to protect mankind... no, to protect Miki. But in the end, I lost Miki.\n\nAnd you lost {s} too...
That's not certain yet.
Didn't Shinichi say so?\n\nThat Maria's telling him the world has started to repair itself.
That's right! When we go back to our world, Miki-chan might...
Be alive? No, I'm sure she's safe!
There's hope after all!\n\nI bet {s}'s safe too!
Yeah!
{p}! You're my best friend! Same as Ryo here! Don't you ever forget it!
Thanks, Akira-kun!
This is... the Makimura house?\n\nRyo? Hey, where are you? ...He's not here.
Waaah!
Hey! Get back here!
Miki!
Oh, Akira-kun, welcome home! Help me catch Tare-chan!
How on earth...
Tare-chan wet the bed again!
But! I dreamed big bro Akira turned into a devil!
